page.overview:
Who is "Jaws" Jackson?

https://jurassicpark.fandom.com/wiki/The_Lost_World_Series_1|family=Unknown|born=Unknown|died=Unknown}}

"Jaws" Jackson is the third member of the Dino Trackers from Jurassic Park Series 2 toyline. He is half Blackfoot native American, and has a PhD from Colombia University. He joined the Dino Trackers because he was interested in studying the dinosaurs on Isla Nublar as well as to protect them from poachers. He is also an expert Tracker and led the most comprehensive grizzly bear study ever conducted.

Jackson is repainted in The Lost World Series 1 for an exclusive with a Utahraptor and capture gear. (Which is shown here)
